title: Finite division rings are commutative
statement: Let $D$ be a division ring: a nonzero unital ring in which every nonzero element has a multiplicative inverse. Suppose its underlying set is finite. Then $xy=yx$ for every $x,y\in D$, so the given ring operations make $D$ a field [def-weil-field].

source.place: Expose XVII, proof of Lemma 7.4.7, second reduction, p. 307: Wedderburn theorem on finite division rings; the proof cites Lam 1991, 13.1.
